name: PanVK Kbase — RC5-universal-113
displayVersion: RC5-universal-113 (Mesa 5a07217f, csf-v11 018-231 + jm-v9 + jm-v7 + jm-v7-wip 0006-0092; v6/v7/v9/v10/v11 in one .so)
author: abhay-byte
description: Experimental PanVK driver for Mali GPUs on mali_kbase: Bifrost JM v6/v7, Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14 in one .so. RC5-universal-113 backs the CSF device TLS only for the shader cores that exist (sparse core masks) and shrinks it after idle, and stops the command pool auto-trim from freeing and re-creating BOs every reset, on top of the RC5-universal-112 memory work. Bundled in this APK.
